primary: Channel candidate must beat native, existing single neural, existing rewriter, previous benign retrieval, same-channel random and joint-pool random by pooled MR in BOTH datasets. Report uniform-shortlist contrast and all repeat outcomes. No outcome-selected case exclusions.
limitations: This is adaptive development after a null YelpChi result, on reused cohorts; not untouched confirmation.

All target membership/order/features and injected features/physical degrees/budgets remain fixed. Known TRAIN labels may guide endpoint eligibility; no VALID/TEST endpoint labels or victim feedback select actions.

The endpoint pool expands from TRAIN-benign to TRAIN-benign plus TRAIN-fraud. This changes the downstream candidate setting and must be reported, although the original attack already knows TRAIN labels.

GAGA has label-grouped relation tokens. Type-aware search borrows the general typed-message idea of HGT and discrete derivative ranking of HotFlip; neither is claimed as a new theorem, HGT implementation or first novelty.

Same-class random conditions on selected donor slots and endpoint classes, isolating within-class endpoint choice. Joint random samples the full legal union, matching slots/dose but not class frequencies. Uniform shortlist searches both classes with the same per-step verification width, without derivative ranking.

Search has twice the per-region shortlist opportunities of the prior benign-only study. Same physical budget is not equal computation. Uniform search controls the new per-step verification count; STOP may change total work.
Both datasets seal before either new official scoring. Fixed TRAIN parity covers both classes and mixed two-substitution combinations; all final new/random graphs are physically checked.
One fixed author upstream and own teacher per dataset, three correlated capture repetitions. No new upstream/teacher training/API/GPU/TEST. Root authorship is not independent or human review.
